comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, the joint return of mfj-two-iras where the primary also contributed 4,000 to a Roth IRA and an ABLE account, 2,500 of it to the Roth. The Roth half is IRC 219(c)(1)(B)(ii)(III)'s reduction term in the spouse's spousal-IRA limit and is sent on /writablePrimaryFilerRothIraContributions; both filers have compensation of their own here, so the limit does not bind and every figure is the parent's.
